findings.issue: The model answer 'when stopping at a word with Mad Ul Mutasil' is too broad. Ṭūl comes in only when you stop on a word whose last letter is the hamzah (e.g. ٱلسَّمَآءِ), because the madd is then also ʿāriḍ. Stopping on a word where the hamzah is not last gives no ṭūl.

summary: All 48 questions in Mudood 1–6 (teacher version) checked. The mcq, select_all and count keys are correct: every Qur'anic option and passage matches tanzil (only some madd signs are dropped from options, as last year), and the count keys (3, 2, 4) are right, including the hā' at-tanbīh in هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ. Real problems: the An-Najm tap prompt ('if you did not stop') disagrees with its within-ayah key; Mudood-5 Q4 has a placeholder rubric; Mudood-6 Q6 gives 2 marks to a voice task, which the seeder zeroes, so the total silently drops from 18 to 16. Systemic: قسر for قصر appears in three papers (M2 Q3, M4 Q3, M5 Q5), even though the teacher flagged it. The waqf match labels are truncated from a cropped screenshot; the full text is in last year's form export.
